load_conv2d_with_weights: load a Conv2d layer with weight and bias from checkpoint weights using init_empty_weights
load_conv2d_no_bias: load a Conv2d layer with weight only and no bias from checkpoint weights
monkey_patch_conv2d_load: monkey-patch torch.nn.Conv2d with a load classmethod to load layers from weights
review_conv_layer_loading: review the Conv2d load and load_no_bias methods for correct weight and bias handling
refactor_conv2d_loading: refactor the Conv2d load methods to support additional layer parameters like padding or dilation
